rows.text: Board approves up to Rs 185 cr for a Phase-3 expansion of Specialized Magnet Winding Wires at its Supa facility, lifting capacity to ~72,200 MT by Q1 FY29

receives **Consent to Operate from the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board for its Supa plant on 9 September, taking approved magnet winding wire capacity there to 28,800 MTPA**, valid to 31 August 2027.
